topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture framework on cancer evolution and outlines the key learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic Selection and Epigenetic Drivers in Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how Darwinian clonal selection of genetic mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations drive tumor evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchy, stemness properties, and specific cells of origin determine tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion, Stromal Support, and Coevolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how microenvironmental and inflammatory factors promote tumor development, how these cellular interactions are investigated, and how they synthesize into a coevolutionary model of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
